name: extension-host core + desktop + workspace 1.0.2
comment: The signed application as shipped: desktop 1.0.0 and workspace release/schema 1.0.2, the repaired actions with the
first cut of native discovery, Query.workspaceSpecialLocations. Its design differs from the 1.0.1 profile's
(core-desktop-workspace-repair-extension-host.json, held to the retained 1.0.1 bundle) by that query root and the types
it reaches, so its canonical digest differs on the same host and printer. The candidate versions are pinned here, apart
from the SDL and the digest, because an identical schema and digest cannot say which binary ran.
